responsibility: Serves as the master declarative database of rs6000 builtin functions. It groups builtins by enabling predicate, records each builtin’s public prototype, internal identifier, expansion pattern name, and special attributes such as vec_init, overloaded handling, MMA, HTM, endianness, or cpu-query semantics, and is consumed by rs6000-gen-builtins.cc to generate the enums, type tables, declarations, and metadata that drive builtin registration and expansion.
